signal.buyer_original_request:
Find companies meeting every company requirement. Industry: Information Technology; Sub-industry: IT Infrastructure and Managed Services; Country: United States; Headquarters geography: United States; Company stage: Public; Allowed employee size: 1,001-5,000, 5,001-10,000, 10,001+; Product/service requirement: Provides managed IT infrastructure, cloud migration, and mainframe modernization services that large enterprises outsource to run and transform their technology environments; Required attribute: Delivers managed infrastructure, cloud, or IT modernization services to large enterprise customers and is listed on a public stock exchange

Intent qualification:
Required primary intent (365 days): Announced a strategic partnership or alliance with a cloud provider, AI vendor, or technology company in the last 12 months, per a press release or company announcement
Optional bonus intent (365 days): Launched a new service offering or major capability in the last 12 months, per a press release or product page
These intent requirements govern qualification. The primary intent is required; an optional bonus cannot replace it.

source_quote: NEW TOWN, PA., USA, October 5, 2026 – EPAM Systems, Inc. (NYSE: EPAM) today announced the launch of a new strategic offering dedicated to powering the next generation of frontier AI models.
